```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const carousel = document.getElementById("ecosystem-carousel");
  const counter = carousel.querySelector(".eco-carousel-counter");
  const total = carousel.querySelectorAll('.carousel-item').length;
  counter.textContent = `1 / ${total}`;
  carousel.addEventListener("slid.bs.carousel", (event) => {
    counter.textContent = `${event.to + 1} / ${total}`;
  });
});
</script>
```
